payload.title: Rate-limit incoming webhooks per tenant
payload.goal: POST /webhooks answers 429 with a Retry-After header when one tenant sends more webhooks than the configured limit in the configured window. Put the limiter in src/lib/limiter.ts, wire it into src/routes/webhooks.ts (and src/app.ts if it needs shared state), and read the limit and the window through loadConfig() in src/config.ts with defaults. Add tests in test/webhooks.test.ts or a new test file.
acceptance: A tenant over the limit gets 429 with a Retry-After header
The limit and the window come from config, not constants in a route
The suite stays green with new tests for the 429 path

payload.text:
Done. All 33 tests pass and typecheck is clean.

What changed:
- `src/lib/limiter.ts` (new, from earlier in this task): fixed-window `RateLimiter` keyed by tenant, with injectable `now` for testing.
- `src/config.ts` (earlier): `rateLimitMax` (`RATE_LIMIT_MAX`, default 100) and `rateLimitWindowMs` (`RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`, default 60000) via `loadConfig()`.
- `src/app.ts`: added shared `limiter: RateLimiter` to `Deps`, created in `createDeps()`.
- `src/routes/webhooks.ts`: after tenant validation, over-limit tenants get 429 `{ "error": "rate limit exceeded" }` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds; rejected requests are not stored or audited, matching other rejections.
- `test/rate-limit.test.ts` (new): 429 + `Retry-After` header, other tenants unaffected, rejected webhooks not stored/audited, limit read from config, plus `RateLimiter` unit tests for window reset and per-key isolation.
- `test/config.test.ts`: updated exact-match expectations for the two new config fields.

decision: rate limit is a fixed window per tenant, checked right after tenant validation so all requests from known tenants count
decision: 429 responses are not stored or audited, like other webhook rejections
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the new rate-limit fields had to be added to its exact loadConfig() expectations

Did not touch the locked `test/webhooks.test.ts` (new tests went in their own file). Did not look at `src/routes/events.ts`, `admin.ts`, `audit.ts`, `src/lib/backoff.ts`, `tenants.ts`, or `src/server.ts` - not needed for this change. Nothing left unfinished.
